subject: website
name: SEOskills agent discovery test page
summary: A static page of plain HTML and CSS with no scripts, no external addresses and no network request beyond its own files. Plain HTML served as written is its own public source, and it runs no external code. Nothing it does relies on a server, and it shows the visitor to no one, so it is Level 4 with privacy. Text meant for AI agents was ignored.

operations.name: Read the static page text
operations.note: The page only displays text and links to three markdown files in the same build. It has no scripts, forms or buttons that act.
